Stocks are back at records, driven by hopes of easing geopolitical tensions. This is good for your tech/chip heavy book, especially since you're on margin.

SOXL is still a SELL at -44.87%, and SPAL is a NEW position at -47.97%. Both are leveraged and decay, making them extra risky on margin.

Keep an eye on SMCI and AVGO. Both have strong scanner setups and are in sectors that tend to move with the broader market.

Bottom line: Manage your leveraged positions and watch for opportunities in strong tech names.
plays: SOXL: TRIM - Leveraged ETF, decays. Consider reducing exposure.
